message.content: {"hts_code": "8544.42.9000", "reason": "The insulated aluminum conductor bars fitted with connectors are electrical conductor assemblies for a voltage not exceeding 1,000 V, classified as other electric conductors fitted with connectors."
message.reasoning_content: Busbar with insulation — likely 8544.30 (insulated cable assemblies) or 8538.90? Aluminum conductor bar in molded housing — likely classified as insulated conductor assembly 8544.42? High-voltage busbar assemblies often 8544.30? Actually 8544.30 is winding wire of copper. Busbars: 8544 for insulated wire/cable; rigid busbars often 8536.90 or 8544.42.9... CBP rulings classify insulated busbars under 8544.30? No—8544.30 is winding wire. Likely 8544.42.90 (other electric conductors, fitted with connectors, ≤1000V) but 24kV dielectric... rated voltage? EV ~400V. Use 8544.42.9000.
